events.title: 🚨 SOMETHING HAS GONE WRONG 🚨
events.summary: At some point this was supposed to be a normal game.Now it’s Splatchinko.You launch eyeballs into space. They hit things. Planets explode. Numbers go up. Reality becomes questionable.I kept adding stuff and now I’m not sure if:it’s a gamea simulationor a mistake that gained sentienceAnyway — the DEMO is OUT NOW.👉 Play it. Break it. Tell me if it makes sense. Or don’t.👉 Wishlist if you survive.Good luck.
